summary: Pend Oreille County, WA 40-foot pole L-4 tower built 1935; removed or destroyed in 1955 (sources disagree); site remains noted in a 2023 trip report.

facts.design: 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1955; sources disagree on which

visit.trail_note: Hike of 1.8 miles one way with about 1,200 feet of gain, from Mystic Lake along an old overgrowing road; site notes list footings, anchors, cable and glass; no views at the summit in 2023 ; the trip report warns that straying into a home site backyard means going too far (WillhiteWeb trip report)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says removed in 1955, FireLookout and WillhiteWeb say destroyed in 1955, and Washington Lookouts says only Removed. The story reports the disagreement and gives 1955 as the end date, which FFLOS, FireLookout and WillhiteWeb share.

notes_for_editor: Elevation: the record's 1262.5 m matches FFLOS's 4,142 ft (1,262 m), so it was not changed. WillhiteWeb's Access: Any vehicle conflicts with the 1.8-mile hike it describes, so public status is left unknown. The trip report warns about private home sites along the route; the story now repeats that warning. No staffing or fire history appears in any source read.
